notes.title: Major Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

We received a lot of useful feedback! Thanks to you we made a lot of improvements:

- Aiming takes less time, so now it's more fun.
- Due to fans feedback, the difficulty of the game is reduced.
- Enemy skills become better as you progress.
- Most of your choices through the game affect the last scene.
- Better look at some levels with new nice backgrounds.
- Fixed some critical bugs.
- Grammatical corrections in the text.

All of this is in the new version of Early Access! You can try it right now and give us feedback! 
Happy Gaming!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33042786/70b79136d8289faa80e98d3afd62f15d5db9067d.png
